description: Counts pairs of positions i < j whose values add to target. Returns 0 for a null or empty array; sums are calculated as long values to avoid int addition overflow.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countMatchingValues
signature: public static long countMatchingValues(int[] first, int[] second)
description: Counts all cross-array position pairs whose values match, so repeated values contribute once for each matching combination of positions. A null or empty array is treated as having no positions, so the result is 0.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countEqualCharacterPairs
description: Counts pairs of positions i < j containing the same character. A null or empty String has no positions and returns 0.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: hasPairWithSum
signature: public static boolean hasPairWithSum(int[] values, int target)
description: Returns true if any pair of positions i < j has values that add to target, and false otherwise. Returns false for a null array or an array with fewer than two elements.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: printPairIndicesWithSum
signature: public static void printPairIndicesWithSum(int[] values, int target)
description: Prints each pair of indices i < j whose values add to target, one pair per line as "i j". Prints nothing for a null or empty array.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countIncreasingPairs
description: Counts pairs of positions i < j where values[i] < values[j]. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countIncreasingPairs(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (values[i] < values[j]) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsAtIndexGap
signature: public static long countPairsAtIndexGap(int[] values, int gap)
description: Counts pairs i < j whose index difference j - i equals gap. Returns 0 for a null or empty array, or when gap is not positive.
code_b: public static long countPairsAtIndexGap(int[] values, int gap) { if (values == null || values.length == 0 || gap <= 0 || gap >= values.length) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length - gap; i++) { count++; } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithProduct
signature: public static long countPairsWithProduct(int[] values, long target)
description: Counts pairs i < j whose values have a product equal to target. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithProduct(int[] values, long target) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if ((long) values[i] * values[j] == target) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countEvenBeforeOddPairs
description: Counts pairs i < j where values[i] is even and values[j] is odd. Returns 0 for a null array or an array with fewer than two elements.
code_b: public static long countEvenBeforeOddPairs(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length < 2) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] % 2 == 0) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (values[j] % 2 != 0) { count++; } } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: firstCommonValueIndex
signature: public static int firstCommonValueIndex(int[] first, int[] second)
description: Returns the index in first of its earliest value that also occurs in second. Returns -1 if either array is null, either array is empty, or no value is shared.
code_b: public static int firstCommonValueIndex(int[] first, int[] second) { if (first == null || second == null || first.length == 0 || second.length == 0) { return -1; } for (int i = 0; i < first.length; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < second.length; j++) { if (first[i] == second[j]) { return i; } } } return -1; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countCrossArrayGreaterPairs
signature: public static long countCrossArrayGreaterPairs(int[] first, int[] second)
description: Counts all cross-array pairs (i, j) where first[i] > second[j]. Returns 0 if either array is null or empty.
code_b: public static long countCrossArrayGreaterPairs(int[] first, int[] second) { if (first == null || second == null || first.length == 0 || second.length == 0) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < first.length; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < second.length; j++) { if (first[i] > second[j]) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithExactlyOneZero
description: Counts pairs i < j where exactly one of the two values is zero. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithExactlyOneZero(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if ((values[i] == 0 && values[j] != 0) || (values[i] != 0 && values[j] == 0)) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countSameStrictSignPairs
description: Counts pairs i < j where both values are positive or both are negative; zero is not counted as either sign. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countSameStrictSignPairs(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if ((values[i] > 0 && values[j] > 0) || (values[i] < 0 && values[j] < 0)) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithAbsoluteDifference
signature: public static long countPairsWithAbsoluteDifference(int[] values, int difference)
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions i < j whose values have the given absolute difference. Returns 0 for a null or empty array, or when difference is negative.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithAbsoluteDifference(int[] values, int difference) { if (values == null || values.length == 0 || difference < 0) return 0; long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (Math.abs((long) values[i] - values[j]) == difference) count++; } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithSameRemainder
signature: public static long countPairsWithSameRemainder(int[] values, int divisor)
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions whose values have the same nonnegative remainder when divided by the absolute value of divisor. Returns 0 for a null or empty array, or when divisor is 0.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithSameRemainder(int[] values, int divisor) { if (values == null || values.length == 0 || divisor == 0) return 0; long modulus = Math.abs((long) divisor); long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (Math.floorMod((long) values[i], modulus) == Math.floorMod((long) values[j], modulus)) count++; } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithOppositeSigns
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions where one value is strictly negative and the other is strictly positive; zero is not counted as either sign. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithOppositeSigns(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return 0; long negativeCount = 0; long positiveCount = 0; for (int value : values) { if (value < 0) negativeCount++; else if (value > 0) positiveCount++; } return negativeCount * positiveCount; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithOddSum
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions whose values add to an odd number. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithOddSum(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return 0; long evenCount = 0; long oddCount = 0; for (int value : values) { if ((value & 1) == 0) evenCount++; else oddCount++; } return evenCount * oddCount; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithIndexSum
signature: public static long countPairsWithIndexSum(int[] values, int indexSum)
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions i < j whose indices add up to indexSum; the array values are not used. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithIndexSum(int[] values, int indexSum) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return 0; long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if ((long) i + j == indexSum) count++; } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsOfDigits
description: Counts pairs of distinct character positions in which both characters are ASCII digits from '0' through '9'. Returns 0 for a null or empty String.
code_b: public static long countPairsOfDigits(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) return 0; long seenDigits = 0; long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char character = text.charAt(i); if (character >= '0' && character <= '9') { count += seenDigits; seenDigits++; } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithBothValuesInRange
signature: public static long countPairsWithBothValuesInRange(int[] values, int minimum, int maximum)
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions i < j where both values are within the inclusive range [minimum, maximum]. Returns 0 for a null or empty array, or when minimum is greater than maximum.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithBothValuesInRange(int[] values, int minimum, int maximum) { if (values == null || values.length == 0 || minimum > maximum) return 0; long inRangeCount = 0; for (int value : values) { if (value >= minimum && value <= maximum) inRangeCount++; } return inRangeCount * (inRangeCount - 1) / 2; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countCrossArraySameParityPairs
signature: public static long countCrossArraySameParityPairs(int[] first, int[] second)
description: Counts pairs made from one position in each array whose values have the same parity. Returns 0 if either array is null or empty.
code_b: public static long countCrossArraySameParityPairs(int[] first, int[] second) { if (first == null || first.length == 0 || second == null || second.length == 0) return 0; long firstEven = 0; long firstOdd = 0; long secondEven = 0; long secondOdd = 0; for (int value : first) { if ((value & 1) == 0) firstEven++; else firstOdd++; } for (int value : second) { if ((value & 1) == 0) secondEven++; else secondOdd++; } return firstEven * secondEven + firstOdd * secondOdd; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithDisjointSetBits
description: Counts unordered pairs of distinct positions whose values have a bitwise AND of zero. Returns 0 when values is null or empty; signed integers are checked using their usual Java bit patterns.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithSameDigitCount
description: Counts unordered pairs whose values have the same number of decimal digits, ignoring a leading minus sign. Returns 0 when values is null or empty; zero has one digit.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWhereLaterIsMultiple
description: Counts pairs of positions i < j where values[i] is nonzero and values[j] is an integer multiple of values[i]. Returns 0 when values is null or empty; a later value of zero counts as a multiple of any nonzero earlier value.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countStringPairsWithSameLength
description: Counts unordered pairs of non-null array entries whose strings have the same length. Returns 0 when words is null or empty; empty strings count as length zero, while null entries are skipped.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countStringPairsWithMatchingEndCharacters
description: Counts pairs of positions i < j where both strings are non-null and nonempty, and the first character of words[i] equals the last character of words[j]. Returns 0 when words is null or empty; null and empty entries are skipped.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsWithXor
signature: public static long countPairsWithXor(int[] values, int target)
description: Counts unordered pairs of distinct positions whose values have a bitwise XOR equal to target. Returns 0 when values is null or empty; negative values use Java's usual signed integer bit patterns.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsOfPerfectSquares
description: Counts unordered pairs of positions where both values are nonnegative perfect squares. Returns 0 when values is null or empty; negative values are not perfect squares for this method.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countMatchingValuesAtSameIndex
signature: public static long countMatchingValuesAtSameIndex(int[] first, int[] second)
description: Counts indices where the two arrays contain the same value at that exact index. Returns 0 if either array is null or if either is empty; when lengths differ, only indices in the shared prefix are checked.

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countCrossArrayPairsWithSum
signature: public static long countCrossArrayPairsWithSum(int[] first, int[] second, int target)
description: Returns the number of pairs of positions, one from each array, whose values sum to target. A null array is treated as empty, and the count is a long.
code_b: public static long countCrossArrayPairsWithSum(int[] first, int[] second, int target) { long count = 0; if (first == null || second == null) { return 0; } for (int i = 0; i < first.length; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < second.length; j++) { if ((long) first[i] + second[j] == target) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsAtIndicesWithSameParity
description: Counts pairs of distinct positions i < j whose zero-based indices have the same parity; the array values do not affect the result. A null or empty array returns 0.
code_b: public static long countPairsAtIndicesWithSameParity(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long evenCount = (values.length + 1L) / 2; long oddCount = values.length / 2L; return evenCount * (evenCount - 1) / 2 + oddCount * (oddCount - 1) / 2; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsOfNonzeroValues
description: Counts pairs of positions i < j where both values are nonzero. A null array or an array with fewer than two elements returns 0.
code_b: public static long countPairsOfNonzeroValues(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length < 2) { return 0; } long nonzeroCount = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] != 0) { nonzeroCount++; } } return nonzeroCount * (nonzeroCount - 1) / 2; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsAtDivisiblePositiveIndices
description: Counts pairs of positions 1 <= i < j where j is divisible by i; array values are ignored. A null array or an array with fewer than three elements returns 0.
code_b: public static long countPairsAtDivisiblePositiveIndices(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length < 3) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 1; i < values.length; i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (j % i == 0) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsOfPowersOfTwo
description: Counts pairs of positions i < j where both values are positive powers of two. A null array or an array with fewer than two qualifying values returns 0.
code_b: public static long countPairsOfPowersOfTwo(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length < 2) { return 0; } long powerCount = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { int value = values[i]; if (value > 0 && (value & (value - 1)) == 0) { powerCount++; } } return powerCount * (powerCount - 1) / 2; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countStringPrefixPairs
description: Counts pairs of non-null strings where either string starts with the other; an empty string is a prefix of every non-null string. A null array is treated as empty, and null elements are ignored.
code_b: public static long countStringPrefixPairs(String[] words) { if (words == null) { return 0; } long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null) { for (int j = i + 1; j < words.length; j++) { if (words[j] != null && (words[i].startsWith(words[j]) || words[j].startsWith(words[i]))) { count++; } } } } return count; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: countPairsOfUppercaseCharacters
description: Counts pairs of positions whose characters are both uppercase according to Character.isUpperCase. A null or empty array returns 0.
code_b: public static long countPairsOfUppercaseCharacters(char[] letters) { if (letters == null || letters.length == 0) { return 0; } long uppercaseCount = 0; for (int i = 0; i < letters.length; i++) { if (Character.isUpperCase(letters[i])) { uppercaseCount++; } } return uppercaseCount * (uppercaseCount - 1) / 2; }

topic: nested loops over pairs of positions (i, j): counting pairs, duplicates, pair sums, matching elements of two arrays
name: hasPairWithDifferentFlags
description: Returns true if two distinct positions contain different boolean values, and false otherwise. A null array, empty array, or single-element array returns false.
code_b: public static boolean hasPairWithDifferentFlags(boolean[] flags) { if (flags == null || flags.length < 2) { return false; } boolean firstValue = flags[0]; for (int i = 1; i < flags.length; i++) { if (flags[i] != firstValue) { return true; } } return false; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countVowels
description: Counts English vowels (a, e, i, o, u), ignoring case. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int countVowels(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (c == 'a' || c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o' || c == 'u' || c == 'A' || c == 'E' || c == 'I' || c == 'O' || c == 'U') { count++; } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countDigits
description: Counts ASCII digits from '0' through '9'. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int countDigits(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { count++; } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: reverseText
description: Returns the characters in reverse order. Returns an empty string for null or empty input.
code_b: public static String reverseText(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return ""; } String result = ""; for (int i = text.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) { result += text.charAt(i); } return result; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: isPalindrome
description: Checks whether the string reads the same forward and backward, using exact character comparisons. Returns false for null and true for an empty string.
code_b: public static boolean isPalindrome(String text) { if (text == null) { return false; } int left = 0; int right = text.length() - 1; while (left < right) { if (text.charAt(left) != text.charAt(right)) { return false; } left++; right--; } return true; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countRuns
description: Counts maximal consecutive groups of identical characters; for example, "aabb" has 2 runs. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int countRuns(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 1; for (int i = 1; i < text.length(); i++) { if (text.charAt(i) != text.charAt(i - 1)) { count++; } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: longestRunLength
description: Returns the length of the longest consecutive run of identical characters. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int longestRunLength(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int longest = 1; int current = 1; for (int i = 1; i < text.length(); i++) { if (text.charAt(i) == text.charAt(i - 1)) { current++; } else { current = 1; } if (current > longest) { longest = current; } } return longest; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: firstVowelIndex
description: Returns the index of the first English vowel, ignoring case. Returns -1 for null, empty, or vowel-free input.
code_b: public static int firstVowelIndex(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return -1; } for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (c == 'a' || c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o' || c == 'u' || c == 'A' || c == 'E' || c == 'I' || c == 'O' || c == 'U') { return i; } } return -1; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countDigitsInLines
description: Counts ASCII digits from '0' through '9' across all non-null strings in the array. Returns 0 for a null or empty array; null elements are skipped.
code_b: public static int countDigitsInLines(String[] lines) { if (lines == null || lines.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { if (lines[i] != null) { for (int j = 0; j < lines[i].length(); j++) { char c = lines[i].charAt(j); if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { count++; } } } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countConsonants
description: Counts ASCII consonant letters, ignoring other characters and treating uppercase and lowercase letters alike. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int countConsonants(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if ((c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')) { if (c != 'A' && c != 'E' && c != 'I' && c != 'O' && c != 'U' && c != 'a' && c != 'e' && c != 'i' && c != 'o' && c != 'u') { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countUppercaseLetters
description: Counts ASCII uppercase letters only. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int countUppercaseLetters(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') { count++; } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: sumDigits
description: Returns the sum of the values of ASCII digits in the string, ignoring all other characters. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int sumDigits(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { sum += c - '0'; } } return sum; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: findLastOccurrence
signature: public static int findLastOccurrence(String text, char target)
description: Returns the index of the last occurrence of target, or -1 if it is not found. Returns -1 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int findLastOccurrence(String text, char target) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return -1; } for (int i = text.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (text.charAt(i) == target) { return i; } } return -1; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: removeDigits
description: Returns a copy of the string with ASCII digits removed and all other characters preserved. Returns an empty string for null or empty input.
code_b: public static String removeDigits(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return ""; } StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(); for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (c < '0' || c > '9') { result.append(c); } } return result.toString(); }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countStringsContainingDigit
description: Counts array elements that contain at least one ASCII digit; null elements are ignored. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static int countStringsContainingDigit(String[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] != null) { boolean containsDigit = false; for (int j = 0; j < values[i].length(); j++) { char c = values[i].charAt(j); if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { containsDigit = true; break; } } if (containsDigit) { count++; } } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: countWords
description: Counts non-empty sequences of non-whitespace characters, using Character.isWhitespace to identify separators. Returns 0 for null or empty input.
code_b: public static int countWords(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; boolean insideWord = false; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char c = text.charAt(i); if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) { insideWord = false; } else if (!insideWord) { count++; insideWord = true; } } return count; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths
name: hasRepeatedCharacter
description: Returns true if any UTF-16 char value occurs at least twice, including spaces or punctuation. Returns false for null or empty input.
code_b: public static boolean hasRepeatedCharacter(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return false; } for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j < text.length(); j++) { if (text.charAt(i) == text.charAt(j)) { return true; } } } return false; }

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths

name: hasAdjacentVowels

name: countVowelsAtEvenIndexes

topic: String processing with charAt and length: counting vowels or digits, reversing, palindromes, run lengths

name: countLowercaseLettersAtOddIndexes

name: countDistinctVowels

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: gradeForScore

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyAverageScore
description: Returns a grade for the average of scores in the range 0–100, using the same thresholds as standard A–F bands (90, 80, 70, and 60). A null or empty array returns "No scores"; any out-of-range score returns "Invalid".

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyAverageOfList
description: Returns an A–F grade for the average of non-null scores from 0 through 100, using thresholds 90, 80, 70, and 60. A null or empty list, or a list containing only nulls, returns "No scores"; null entries are ignored and any out-of-range non-null score returns "Invalid".

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: countRowsWithHotTemperature
description: Returns the number of rows containing at least one temperature of 30 or higher. A null or empty outer array returns 0, and null or empty rows are ignored.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyWindSpeed
description: Returns 0 for speeds from 0 up to but not including 1, 1 for [1, 6), 2 for [6, 12), and 3 for 12 or greater. Returns -1 for negative speeds or NaN; positive infinity is classified as 3.
code_b: public static int classifyWindSpeed(double speed) { if (speed < 0 || Double.isNaN(speed)) { return -1; } if (speed < 1) { return 0; } if (speed < 6) { return 1; } if (speed < 12) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyBatteryPercent
description: Returns -1 when percent is outside 0 through 100. Otherwise, returns 0 for 0–10, 1 for 11–30, 2 for 31–70, and 3 for 71–100; this method takes a primitive number, so null is not applicable.
code_b: public static int classifyBatteryPercent(int percent) { if (percent < 0 || percent > 100) { return -1; } if (percent <= 10) { return 0; } if (percent <= 30) { return 1; } if (percent <= 70) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyPackageWeight
description: Returns -1 for negative, NaN, or infinite weights. For a finite nonnegative weight, returns 0 for up to 1, 1 for over 1 through 5, 2 for over 5 through 20, and 3 for over 20; the weight is measured in kilograms.
code_b: public static int classifyPackageWeight(double weight) { if (weight < 0 || Double.isNaN(weight) || Double.isInfinite(weight)) { return -1; } if (weight <= 1) { return 0; } if (weight <= 5) { return 1; } if (weight <= 20) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyTextLength
description: Returns -1 for null. Otherwise, returns 0 for lengths 0–5, 1 for 6–10, 2 for 11–20, and 3 for lengths over 20; an empty String therefore returns 0.
code_b: public static int classifyTextLength(String text) { if (text == null) { return -1; } int length = text.length(); if (length <= 5) { return 0; } if (length <= 10) { return 1; } if (length <= 20) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyPositiveCount
description: Counts positive elements and returns 0 for a count of 0, 1 for 1–3, 2 for 4–6, and 3 for 7 or more. A null or empty array returns 0; counting stops once the count reaches 7.
code_b: public static int classifyPositiveCount(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length && count < 7; i++) { if (values[i] > 0) { count++; } } if (count == 0) { return 0; } if (count <= 3) { return 1; } if (count <= 6) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyLargestMagnitude
description: Returns -1 for a null or empty array. Otherwise, finds the largest absolute value and returns 0 for 0–9, 1 for 10–99, 2 for 100–999, and 3 for 1000 or more; the calculation safely handles Integer.MIN_VALUE.
code_b: public static int classifyLargestMagnitude(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return -1; } long largest = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { long magnitude = Math.abs((long) values[i]); if (magnitude > largest) { largest = magnitude; } } if (largest <= 9) { return 0; } if (largest <= 99) { return 1; } if (largest <= 999) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyVowelCount
description: Counts English vowels without distinguishing uppercase and lowercase, then returns 0 for no vowels, 1 for 1–2, 2 for 3–5, and 3 for 6 or more. A null or empty String returns 0.
code_b: public static int classifyVowelCount(String text) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) { char letter = Character.toLowerCase(text.charAt(i)); if (letter == 'a' || letter == 'e' || letter == 'i' || letter == 'o' || letter == 'u') { count++; } } if (count == 0) { return 0; } if (count <= 2) { return 1; } if (count <= 5) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyMatrixCellCount
description: Counts cells in all non-null rows and returns 0 for no cells, 1 for 1–5, 2 for 6–20, and 3 for more than 20. A null or empty matrix, or a matrix containing only null or empty rows, returns 0.
code_b: public static int classifyMatrixCellCount(int[][] matrix) { if (matrix == null) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < matrix.length; i++) { if (matrix[i] != null) { for (int j = 0; j < matrix[i].length; j++) { count++; if (count > 20) { return 3; } } } } if (count == 0) { return 0; } if (count <= 5) { return 1; } return 2; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyTemperatureCelsius
description: Returns 0 for at or below 0°C, 1 for above 0°C through 15°C, 2 for above 15°C through 25°C, and 3 for above 25°C. Returns -1 for NaN; infinities fall into the corresponding outer bands.
code_b: public static int classifyTemperatureCelsius(double celsius) { if (Double.isNaN(celsius)) { return -1; } if (celsius <= 0.0) { return 0; } if (celsius <= 15.0) { return 1; } if (celsius <= 25.0) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyLatencyMillis
description: Returns -1 for negative latency, 0 through 50 ms, 1 for 51–150 ms, 2 for 151–500 ms, and 3 above 500 ms. This method takes no arrays or Strings, so empty and null inputs do not apply.
code_b: public static int classifyLatencyMillis(int milliseconds) { if (milliseconds < 0) { return -1; } if (milliseconds <= 50) { return 0; } if (milliseconds <= 150) { return 1; } if (milliseconds <= 500) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyDailySteps
description: Returns -1 for a negative count, 0 for 0–1,999 steps, 1 for 2,000–7,499, 2 for 7,500–9,999, and 3 for 10,000 or more. This method takes no arrays or Strings, so empty and null inputs do not apply.
code_b: public static int classifyDailySteps(int steps) { if (steps < 0) { return -1; } if (steps <= 1999) { return 0; } if (steps <= 7499) { return 1; } if (steps <= 9999) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyElevationMeters
description: Returns -1 for elevations below 0 or above 8,849 meters, 0 for 0–499 m, 1 for 500–1,999 m, 2 for 2,000–4,999 m, and 3 for 5,000–8,849 m. This method takes no arrays or Strings, so empty and null inputs do not apply.
code_b: public static int classifyElevationMeters(int meters) { if (meters < 0 || meters > 8849) { return -1; } if (meters <= 499) { return 0; } if (meters <= 1999) { return 1; } if (meters <= 4999) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyPacketLossPercent
description: Returns -1 for values below 0, above 100, or NaN; returns 0 through 1%, 1 above 1% through 3%, 2 above 3% through 5%, and 3 above 5%. Infinities are out of range.
code_b: public static int classifyPacketLossPercent(double percent) { if (Double.isNaN(percent) || percent < 0.0 || percent > 100.0) { return -1; } if (percent <= 1.0) { return 0; } if (percent <= 3.0) { return 1; } if (percent <= 5.0) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyLongestHotStreak
description: Classifies the longest consecutive streak of days at or above 30°C: 0 for no such days, 1 for a streak of 1–2 days, 2 for 3–5 days, and 3 for 6 or more days. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static int classifyLongestHotStreak(int[] dailyTemperatures) { if (dailyTemperatures == null || dailyTemperatures.length == 0) { return 0; } int longest = 0; int current = 0; for (int i = 0; i < dailyTemperatures.length; i++) { if (dailyTemperatures[i] >= 30) { current++; if (current > longest) { longest = current; } } else { current = 0; } } if (longest == 0) { return 0; } if (longest <= 2) { return 1; } if (longest <= 5) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyAverageMonthlyRainfall
description: Returns 0 when the average is 0–9.9 mm, 1 for 10–49.9 mm, 2 for 50–99.9 mm, and 3 for 100 mm or more. Returns 0 for a null or empty array, and -1 if any entry is negative or NaN; positive infinity falls in band 3.
code_b: public static int classifyAverageMonthlyRainfall(double[] rainfall) { if (rainfall == null || rainfall.length == 0) { return 0; } double total = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < rainfall.length; i++) { if (Double.isNaN(rainfall[i]) || rainfall[i] < 0.0) { return -1; } total += rainfall[i]; } double average = total / rainfall.length; if (average < 10.0) { return 0; } if (average < 50.0) { return 1; } if (average < 100.0) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyMatchingNeighborPairs
description: Counts equal horizontally or vertically adjacent pairs, then returns 0 for none, 1 for 1–3 pairs, 2 for 4–10 pairs, and 3 for more than 10 pairs. Returns 0 for a null or empty grid; null rows are treated as empty.
code_b: public static int classifyMatchingNeighborPairs(int[][] grid) { if (grid == null || grid.length == 0) { return 0; } int pairs = 0; for (int row = 0; row < grid.length; row++) { if (grid[row] != null) { for (int column = 0; column < grid[row].length - 1; column++) { if (grid[row][column] == grid[row][column + 1]) { pairs++; if (pairs > 10) { return 3; } } } } } for (int row = 0; row < grid.length - 1; row++) { int[] current = grid[row]; int[] next = grid[row + 1]; if (current != null && next != null) { int limit = Math.min(current.length, next.length); for (int column = 0; column < limit; column++) { if (current[column] == next[column]) { pairs++; if (pairs > 10) { return 3; } } } } } if (pairs == 0) { return 0; } if (pairs <= 3) { return 1; } if (pairs <= 10) { return 2; } return 3; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyBookPages
description: Returns short for fewer than 100 pages, medium for 100–299, and long for 300 or more. Negative page counts return invalid.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyPoolDepthCm
description: Returns invalid for NaN or negative depths; otherwise, depths below 0.5 cm are shallow, below 1.5 cm are wading, below 3 cm are deep, and the rest are very deep. Positive infinity is classified as very deep.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyCaffeineDoseMg
description: Returns invalid for a negative dose, low below 80 mg, moderate below 200 mg, high below 400 mg, and very high for 400 mg or more.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyDownloadSpeedMbps
description: Returns invalid for NaN or negative speeds, slow below 10 Mbps, basic below 50 Mbps, fast below 200 Mbps, and ultra-fast otherwise. Positive infinity is classified as ultra-fast.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyHeavyParcelCount
description: Counts parcels weighing at least 20 kg, then returns none for zero, few for 1–3, several for 4–9, or many for 10 or more. A null or empty array returns none; negative weights are ignored.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyRowsWithHotCell
description: Counts rows containing at least one temperature of 35 or more, then returns none for zero, few for 1–2, several for 3–7, or many for 8 or more. A null or empty matrix returns none; null and empty rows are skipped.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyHighScoreCount
description: Counts scores from 70 through 100 inclusive, then returns none for zero, few for 1–2, several for 3–5, or many for 6 or more. A null or empty list returns none; null entries and scores outside 0–100 are ignored.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyHighDigitCount
description: Counts characters that are decimal digits from 7 through 9, then returns none for zero, few for 1–2, several for 3–5, or many for 6 or more. A null or empty array returns none; non-digit characters are ignored.

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyWaterHardness
description: Returns soft for 0–60 ppm, moderate for above 60–120, hard for above 120–180, and very hard above 180; negative values are invalid. NaN returns unknown; infinities follow the threshold rules.
code_b: public static String classifyWaterHardness(double ppm) { if (Double.isNaN(ppm)) return "unknown"; if (ppm < 0) return "invalid"; if (ppm <= 60) return "soft"; if (ppm <= 120) return "moderate"; if (ppm <= 180) return "hard"; return "very hard"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyFuelEconomy
description: Returns low for 0–15 mpg, fair for above 15–25, good for above 25–35, and excellent above 35; negative values and NaN are invalid. Positive infinity is excellent.
code_b: public static String classifyFuelEconomy(double mpg) { if (Double.isNaN(mpg) || mpg < 0) return "invalid"; if (mpg <= 15) return "low"; if (mpg <= 25) return "fair"; if (mpg <= 35) return "good"; return "excellent"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyHeartRate
description: Returns invalid for rates at or below 0, low below 50, typical from 50 through 100, elevated through 120, and high above 120. The parameter is a primitive, so null and empty inputs do not apply.
code_b: public static String classifyHeartRate(int beatsPerMinute) { if (beatsPerMinute <= 0) return "invalid"; if (beatsPerMinute < 50) return "low"; if (beatsPerMinute <= 100) return "typical"; if (beatsPerMinute <= 120) return "elevated"; return "high"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyArraySum
description: Returns empty for a null or empty array; otherwise classifies the sum as nonpositive (at most 0), small (1–100), medium (101–1000), or large (above 1000).
code_b: public static String classifyArraySum(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return "empty"; long sum = 0; for (int value : values) sum += value; if (sum <= 0) return "nonpositive"; if (sum <= 100) return "small"; if (sum <= 1000) return "medium"; return "large"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyArrayRange
description: Returns empty for a null or empty array; otherwise classifies max minus min as narrow (0–10), moderate (above 10–100), wide (above 100–1000), or very wide (above 1000).
code_b: public static String classifyArrayRange(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) return "empty"; int min = values[0]; int max = values[0]; for (int value : values) { if (value < min) min = value; if (value > max) max = value; } long range = (long) max - min; if (range <= 10) return "narrow"; if (range <= 100) return "moderate"; if (range <= 1000) return "wide"; return "very wide"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyUppercaseShare
description: Returns empty for a null or empty array and no letters if it contains no English letters; otherwise classifies the uppercase share of English letters as low (at most 25%), mixed (above 25% through 75%), or mostly uppercase (above 75%). Nonletters are ignored.
code_b: public static String classifyUppercaseShare(char[] characters) { if (characters == null || characters.length == 0) return "empty"; long letters = 0; long uppercase = 0; for (char character : characters) { if ((character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') || (character >= 'a' && character <= 'z')) { letters++; if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') uppercase++; } } if (letters == 0) return "no letters"; if (uppercase * 4 <= letters) return "low"; if (uppercase * 4 <= letters * 3) return "mixed"; return "mostly uppercase"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyMatrixTotal
description: Returns empty for a null matrix or one with no values; null rows are ignored. Otherwise, classifies the total as nonpositive (at most 0), small (1–100), medium (101–1000), or large (above 1000).
code_b: public static String classifyMatrixTotal(int[][] matrix) { if (matrix == null) return "empty"; long total = 0; boolean hasValues = false; for (int[] row : matrix) { if (row != null) { for (int value : row) { total += value; hasValues = true; } } } if (!hasValues) return "empty"; if (total <= 0) return "nonpositive"; if (total <= 100) return "small"; if (total <= 1000) return "medium"; return "large"; }

topic: classifying a number with an if / else if chain on thresholds: grades, BMI bands, tax brackets, age groups
name: classifyListSpread
description: Returns empty for a null list, an empty list, or a list containing no non-null values; null elements are ignored. Otherwise, classifies max minus min as compact (0–10), moderate (above 10–100), or broad (above 100).
code_b: public static String classifyListSpread(java.util.List<Integer> values) { if (values == null || values.isEmpty()) return "empty"; Integer min = null; Integer max = null; for (Integer value : values) { if (value != null) { if (min == null || value < min) min = value; if (max == null || value > max) max = value; } } if (min == null) return "empty"; long spread = (long) max - min; if (spread <= 10) return "compact"; if (spread <= 100) return "moderate"; return "broad"; }

name: countOddCollatzStepsWithin
signature: public static int countOddCollatzStepsWithin(int start, int maxSteps)
description: Counts representable odd Collatz transitions, stopping at 1 or after maxSteps transitions. Returns 0 for a nonpositive start or nonpositive limit; stops before an odd transition if 3n + 1 would overflow a long.
code_b: public static int countOddCollatzStepsWithin(int start, int maxSteps) { if (start <= 0 || maxSteps <= 0) { return 0; } long number = start; int steps = 0; int oddSteps = 0; while (number != 1 && steps < maxSteps) { if (number % 2 == 0) { number /= 2; } else { if (number > (Long.MAX_VALUE - 1) / 3) { break; } number = 3 * number + 1; oddSteps++; } steps++; } return oddSteps; }

name: countPairsWithEqualDigitSum
description: Counts pairs of different array positions whose values have the same decimal digit sum, using absolute values. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static long countPairsWithEqualDigitSum(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } long pairs = 0; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { long firstNumber = Math.abs((long) values[i]); int firstSum = 0; do { firstSum += firstNumber % 10; firstNumber /= 10; } while (firstNumber > 0); for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { long secondNumber = Math.abs((long) values[j]); int secondSum = 0; do { secondSum += secondNumber % 10; secondNumber /= 10; } while (secondNumber > 0); if (firstSum == secondSum) { pairs++; } } } return pairs; }

description: Returns the longest non-null, non-empty word; ties keep the first word. A null or empty array, or an array with no non-null, non-empty words, returns ""; null elements are ignored.
code_b: public static String longestWord(String[] words) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return ""; } String longest = ""; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null && words[i].length() > longest.length()) { longest = words[i]; } } return longest; }

code_b: public static int countWordsAtLeastLength(String[] words, int minimumLength) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null && words[i].length() >= minimumLength) { count++; } } return count; }

name: joinWithSeparator
signature: public static String joinWithSeparator(String[] words, String separator)
description: Joins all array positions in order, placing the separator between positions; null elements are treated as empty strings. A null or empty array returns "", and a null separator is treated as "".
code_b: public static String joinWithSeparator(String[] words, String separator) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return ""; } if (separator == null) { separator = ""; } String result = ""; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (i > 0) { result += separator; } if (words[i] != null) { result += words[i]; } } return result; }

topic: String arrays: longest word, count words that match a rule, join with a separator, first word alphabetically
name: firstWordAlphabetically
description: Returns the non-null word that comes first in case-sensitive Java alphabetical order; an empty string is a valid word and comes before non-empty strings. A null or empty array, or an array containing only nulls, returns null; ties keep the first matching word.
code_b: public static String firstWordAlphabetically(String[] words) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return null; } String first = null; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null && (first == null || words[i].compareTo(first) < 0)) { first = words[i]; } } return first; }

name: countWordsStartingWith
signature: public static int countWordsStartingWith(String[] words, char letter)
description: Counts non-null, non-empty words whose first character matches letter without regard to case. A null or empty array returns 0, and null or empty elements are ignored.
code_b: public static int countWordsStartingWith(String[] words, char letter) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null && words[i].length() > 0 && Character.toLowerCase(words[i].charAt(0)) == Character.toLowerCase(letter)) { count++; } } return count; }

name: countWordsWithUniqueLetters
description: Counts non-null, non-empty words that contain no repeated characters, comparing characters case-sensitively. A null or empty array returns 0, and null or empty elements are ignored.
code_b: public static int countWordsWithUniqueLetters(String[] words) { if (words == null || words.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] != null && words[i].length() > 0) { boolean unique = true; for (int j = 0; j < words[i].length() && unique; j++) { for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) { if (words[i].charAt(j) == words[i].charAt(k)) { unique = false; break; } } } if (unique) { count++; } } } return count; }

name: countWordsWithAtLeastOneVowel
description: Returns the number of non-null words containing at least one of a, e, i, o, or u, ignoring case. A null array returns 0; null elements and empty strings do not count.
code_b: public static int countWordsWithAtLeastOneVowel(String[] words) { if (words == null) return 0; int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] == null || words[i].length() == 0) continue; boolean hasVowel = false; for (int j = 0; j < words[i].length(); j++) { char c = Character.toLowerCase(words[i].charAt(j)); if (c == 'a' || c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o' || c == 'u') { hasVowel = true; break; } } if (hasVowel) count++; } return count; }

name: countWordsWithAlternatingAsciiLetterCase
description: Counts non-null strings with at least two ASCII letters whose ASCII letters alternate between uppercase and lowercase; all non-ASCII letters and other characters are ignored. A null array returns 0, and null elements or strings with fewer than two ASCII letters do not count.
code_b: public static int countWordsWithAlternatingAsciiLetterCase(String[] words) { if (words == null) return 0; int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] == null) continue; int letterCount = 0; boolean previousUppercase = false; boolean alternating = true; for (int j = 0; j < words[i].length(); j++) { char c = words[i].charAt(j); boolean currentUppercase; if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') { currentUppercase = true; } else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') { currentUppercase = false; } else { continue; } if (letterCount > 0 && currentUppercase == previousUppercase) { alternating = false; break; } previousUppercase = currentUppercase; letterCount++; } if (alternating && letterCount >= 2) count++; } return count; }

name: joinWordsWithExactlyTwoVowels
signature: public static String joinWordsWithExactlyTwoVowels(String[] words, String separator)
description: Joins non-null words containing exactly two standard vowels (a, e, i, o, u, ignoring case), preserving their array order. A null array or no matching words returns an empty string; null elements are ignored, and a null separator is treated as an empty string.
code_b: public static String joinWordsWithExactlyTwoVowels(String[] words, String separator) { if (words == null) return ""; if (separator == null) separator = ""; StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(); boolean hasMatch = false; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] == null) continue; int vowelCount = 0; for (int j = 0; j < words[i].length(); j++) { char c = Character.toLowerCase(words[i].charAt(j)); if (c == 'a' || c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o' || c == 'u') vowelCount++; } if (vowelCount == 2) { if (hasMatch) result.append(separator); result.append(words[i]); hasMatch = true; } } return result.toString(); }

topic: String arrays: longest word, count words that match a rule, join with a separator, first word alphabetically
name: firstWordWithRepeatedCharacter
description: Returns the first non-null word containing any repeated character, comparing characters exactly and distinguishing uppercase from lowercase. Returns null for a null array, when no such word exists, or when all elements are null; empty strings do not match.
code_b: public static String firstWordWithRepeatedCharacter(String[] words) { if (words == null) return null; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] == null || words[i].length() == 0) continue; boolean hasRepeatedCharacter = false; for (int j = 0; j < words[i].length() && !hasRepeatedCharacter; j++) { for (int k = j + 1; k < words[i].length(); k++) { if (words[i].charAt(j) == words[i].charAt(k)) { hasRepeatedCharacter = true; break; } } } if (hasRepeatedCharacter) return words[i]; } return null; }

code_b: public static int countWordsWithEqualLettersAndDigits(String[] words) { if (words == null) return 0; int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { if (words[i] == null || words[i].length() == 0) continue; int letterCount = 0; int digitCount = 0; for (int j = 0; j < words[i].length(); j++) { char c = words[i].charAt(j); if ((c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')) letterCount++; else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') digitCount++; } if (letterCount > 0 && letterCount == digitCount) count++; } return count; }

code_b: public static String reverseWordsIndividually(String text) { if (text == null) { return ""; } String clean = text.trim(); StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(); int index = 0; while (index < clean.length()) { while (index < clean.length() && Character.isWhitespace(clean.charAt(index))) { index++; } if (index >= clean.length()) { break; } int end = index; while (end < clean.length() && !Character.isWhitespace(clean.charAt(end))) { end++; } if (result.length() > 0) { result.append(' '); } for (int charIndex = end - 1; charIndex >= index; charIndex--) { result.append(clean.charAt(charIndex)); } index = end; } return result.toString(); }

code_b: public static int binarySearch(int[] values, int target) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return -1; } int low = 0; int high = values.length - 1; while (low <= high) { int middle = low + (high - low) / 2; if (values[middle] == target) { return middle; } else if (values[middle] < target) { low = middle + 1; } else { high = middle - 1; } } return -1; }

description: Returns the values from start toward end, joined by commas, stepping by 2; direction must be 'U' for upward or 'D' for downward. Returns an empty String for an invalid direction or a range that does not match the direction; a matching range with no visited values also returns an empty String.
code_b: public static String rangeByTwos(int start, int end, char direction) { if (direction == 'U') { if (start > end) { return ""; } } else if (direction == 'D') { if (start < end) { return ""; } } else { return ""; } StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(); if (direction == 'U') { for (long value = start; value <= end; value += 2) { if (result.length() > 0) { result.append(','); } result.append(value); } } else { for (long value = start; value >= end; value -= 2) { if (result.length() > 0) { result.append(','); } result.append(value); } } return result.toString(); }

description: Sums card values using ranks 1–13: ace is 1, ranks 2–10 keep their value, and ranks 11–13 are 10. Returns 0 for a null or empty list and ignores null entries and ranks outside 1–13.
code_b: public static int sumBlackjackValues(List<Integer> ranks) { if (ranks == null || ranks.isEmpty()) return 0; int sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < ranks.size(); i++) { Integer rank = ranks.get(i); if (rank != null && rank >= 1 && rank <= 13) { if (rank >= 11) sum += 10; else sum += rank; } } return sum; }

name: bubbleSortNMinusOne
description: Sorts the array in place using exactly n - 1 bubble-sort passes and returns the same array. A null input returns null; an empty array is returned unchanged.
code_b: public static int[] bubbleSortNMinusOne(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return null; } for (int pass = 0; pass < values.length - 1; pass++) { for (int i = 0; i < values.length - 1 - pass; i++) { if (values[i] > values[i + 1]) { int temp = values[i]; values[i] = values[i + 1]; values[i + 1] = temp; } } } return values; }

name: selectionSort
description: Sorts the array in place using selection sort and returns the same array. A null input returns null; an empty array is returned unchanged.
code_b: public static int[] selectionSort(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return null; } for (int i = 0; i < values.length - 1; i++) { int minIndex = i; for (int j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (values[j] < values[minIndex]) { minIndex = j; } } if (minIndex != i) { int temp = values[i]; values[i] = values[minIndex]; values[minIndex] = temp; } } return values; }

name: insertionSort
description: Sorts the array in place using insertion sort and returns the same array. A null input returns null; an empty array is returned unchanged.
code_b: public static int[] insertionSort(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return null; } for (int i = 1; i < values.length; i++) { int current = values[i]; int j = i - 1; while (j >= 0 && values[j] > current) { values[j + 1] = values[j]; j--; } values[j + 1] = current; } return values; }

name: isSortedAfterOneBubblePass
signature: public static boolean isSortedAfterOneBubblePass(int[] values, int direction)
description: Makes one bubble-sort pass on a copy and returns whether that copy is then sorted; direction 1 means ascending and -1 means descending. For either valid direction, null or empty input returns true; any other direction returns false.
code_b: public static boolean isSortedAfterOneBubblePass(int[] values, int direction) { if (direction != 1 && direction != -1) { return false; } if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return true; } int[] copy = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(values, values.length); for (int i = 0; i < copy.length - 1; i++) { if ((direction == 1 && copy[i] > copy[i + 1]) || (direction == -1 && copy[i] < copy[i + 1])) { int temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[i + 1]; copy[i + 1] = temp; } } for (int i = 1; i < copy.length; i++) { if ((direction == 1 && copy[i] < copy[i - 1]) || (direction == -1 && copy[i] > copy[i - 1])) { return false; } } return true; }

description: Returns the number of actual swaps standard selection sort would perform, without changing the array. A null or empty array returns 0.
code_b: public static int countSelectionSortSwaps(int[] values) { if (values == null) { return 0; } int[] copy = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(values, values.length); int swaps = 0; for (int i = 0; i < copy.length - 1; i++) { int minIndex = i; for (int j = i + 1; j < copy.length; j++) { if (copy[j] < copy[minIndex]) { minIndex = j; } } if (minIndex != i) { int temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[minIndex]; copy[minIndex] = temp; swaps++; } } return swaps; }

name: countBubbleSortPasses
description: Returns the number of bubble-sort passes performed on a copy, stopping early after a pass makes no swaps; arrays of length 0 or 1 need 0 passes. A null input also returns 0.
code_b: public static int countBubbleSortPasses(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length < 2) { return 0; } int[] copy = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(values, values.length); int passes = 0; for (int end = copy.length - 1; end > 0; end--) { boolean swapped = false; for (int i = 0; i < end; i++) { if (copy[i] > copy[i + 1]) { int temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[i + 1]; copy[i + 1] = temp; swapped = true; } } passes++; if (!swapped) { break; } } return passes; }

name: bubbleSortLimited

description: Returns a sorted copy after at most passLimit ascending bubble-sort passes; a negative limit performs no passes. A null array is treated as empty, and the input array is not changed.
code_b: public static int[] bubbleSortLimited(int[] values, int passLimit) { int[] copy = values == null ? new int[0] : values.clone(); for (int pass = 0; pass < passLimit && pass < copy.length - 1; pass++) { boolean swapped = false; for (int i = 0; i < copy.length - 1 - pass; i++) { if (copy[i] > copy[i + 1]) { int temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[i + 1]; copy[i + 1] = temp; swapped = true; } } if (!swapped) { break; } } return copy; }

code_b: public static int[] bubbleSortByMode(int[] values, int mode) { int[] copy = values == null ? new int[0] : values.clone(); if (mode != 0 && mode != 1) { return copy; } for (int pass = 0; pass < copy.length - 1; pass++) { boolean swapped = false; for (int i = 0; i < copy.length - 1 - pass; i++) { if ((mode == 0 && copy[i] > copy[i + 1]) || (mode == 1 && copy[i] < copy[i + 1])) { int temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[i + 1]; copy[i + 1] = temp; swapped = true; } } if (!swapped) { break; } } return copy; }

name: bubbleSortByParityThenValue
description: Returns a copy with even numbers first and odd numbers second, sorting each group in ascending numeric order. A null array is treated as empty, and the input is not changed.
code_b: public static int[] bubbleSortByParityThenValue(int[] values) { int[] copy = values == null ? new int[0] : values.clone(); for (int pass = 0; pass < copy.length - 1; pass++) { boolean swapped = false; for (int i = 0; i < copy.length - 1 - pass; i++) { boolean leftEven = copy[i] % 2 == 0; boolean rightEven = copy[i + 1] % 2 == 0; if ((!leftEven && rightEven) || (leftEven == rightEven && copy[i] > copy[i + 1])) { int temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[i + 1]; copy[i + 1] = temp; swapped = true; } } if (!swapped) { break; } } return copy; }
